hookVerdict: A classic 'tell them I'm not here' sitcom bit - dad dodges a call that turns out to be a Duolingo video call - escalates through repeated bilingual captions until the screen-filling 'Lalalalala' gag breaks the fourth wall for a big comedic release; the joke rewards viewers who stick around to see who's actually calling.

Dad dodges the call; the boy relays his excuse ('he says he's not here') - classic avoidance-comedy beat.
Reveal cut to the video-call screen showing Duo on the line - the actual 'who's calling' payoff.
